dropped_turns.speaker: CON
dropped_turns.text: I grant that a fixed floor can discourage some marginal hiring. But your answer leaves the weakest workers exposed to employers who can wait them out, so keeping the minimum wage remains the fairer protection.

dropped_turns.speaker: PRO
